products.title: Heritage Pleated Slack Pants
products.body_html:
The Heritage Pleated Slack Pant is our gateway drug to the addiction of Student's on-course style. The Heritage is a relaxed, traditional slack with vintage vibes in cut and silhouette, but it is also secretly technical—the proprietary fabric looks like a sophisticated dress pant, but is made of a proprietary performance blend.

Inside the pant, you'll find a silicone-waist "grip strip" that prevents tucked in shirts from moving or coming untucked. The zip-up to exterior button is complemented by the interior anchor button. The anchor secures the pant so the waistband and outer visible button stay perfectly aligned with zero pulling or sagging. If you insist on driving bombs, the Heritage has you covered.

All in all, the Heritage Pleated Slack Pant looks like a classic slack worn by our most stylish Golf forefathers, but performs like modern sportswear. We hope you love it as much as we do.

  • Back pocket flap can be tucked or untucked
  • Fit: Relaxed

  • Anti-Slip inner waistband finished with laser-cut 3M logos.

  • Back pockets: one flap ; one French double-welt
  • YKK Zipper fly
  • Embroidered back pocket and front pocket logos Interior Anchor Button
  • Reinforced Interior Stitching
